"Removable armrests make it easy to add on a chaise lounge." Open base: "Height under furniture: 6 1/4 "" on its 6 1/4" wood legs, the open floor Andrew asked for (2026-10-25: "Sofa must have empty space bettwen like" the MORABO chaise add-on), high enough for a robot vacuum (design-review.md). Cover: Gunnared, "100% polyester (min. 90% recycled)", dope-dyed; "Stationary cover." / "Non-removable cover"; care "Vacuum clean." and wipe clean (Materials and care): it cannot go in a washer, so for dust and mites it is vacuumed, not washed (F-66). Legs "Solid wood, Oak veneer, Clear lacquer", Morabo 6 1/4 " wood. In stock at IKEA Long Island, NY; click and collect (2026-10-25). Also with metal legs ($799.00) and in Gunnared light green. 4.1 stars (164). rooms: living-room, from the brief.
